source_review.scope: All24 JavaScript files under dist/core/tools (16 root plus8 renderer files), plus13 selected directly shared utility bodies. Full local lexical partition; broader Pi graph remains explicitly open.

checks: All finite scoped bodies manually read before extraction; every exact string/template occurrence partitioned as fixed text or reasoned exclusion.
Package versions/root-nested bytes/lock integrity/pinned before-after source differences verified read-only; no runtime/install/patch execution.
Exact per-occurrence branch plus registered-definition, admission, renderer and native/protocol/export routing distinguish display from model/control/API data.

Directory census verifies all24 tools subtree files in both installed trees;13 additional shared files individually enumerated. Durable --negative-controls1 rejects source omission, fixed-text corruption, consumer hash drift and canonical proof corruption in memory.
limits: Finite37 full local bodies only. Remaining core/extension/MCP/RPC/SDK/viewer/assets/prompt/provider/tool graph remains open; these records are not whole-Pi completion.
Default builtin activation read,bash,edit,write can be changed by merged settings/CLI/SDK tools modifiers/noTools/exclusions and same-name custom tools; model prompt metadata is separate from UI.
Native TUI and raw JSON/RPC differ. Read/write/edit successful content can be hidden by native renderers; output remains protocol-visible. Renderer captions are not raw event fields.
HTML export uses viewer templates for bash,read,write,edit,ls; only other tool names use custom TUI prerendering here. Viewer template prose remains pending.
Jouzu codemode override disables script tools and MCP configs map codemode exposure to deferred. Optional SDK APIs/callbacks/operation overrides remain conditional or error-consumer pending.
TextGuard/extension tool hooks can replace or suppress builtin result; arbitrary model/shell/filesystem/network/WASM/extension payload remains data, not locally translated English.
Source-defined public fallback Windows path token C:\Windows is retained exactly in exclusions/evidence. No private local workspace paths are metadata.
English strings are TypeScript-decoded; template expressions retain exact source body without backticks, including escape spellings. Exclusion values JSON-encode source bytes/whitespace.
No online git tag verification, full installed-package comparison, runtime screenshots, locale rendering or cross-platform execution is claimed.
